text: The author employs an alternating first-person point of view, shifting between the perspectives of different members of a space expedition team. The narrative tone varies according to the speaker: it is optimistic and curious when voiced by the scientist, and pragmatic and cautious when voiced by the engineer. Additionally, the language style adapts to the subject matter, utilizing technical terminology for discussions of machinery and phenomena, while becoming more reflective and philosophical when the characters contemplate their existence in the universe.
